cards.quote: But Jean-Marie had no time for indulgence; he had a meeting to attend, one that could make or break his career as a militaires du contingent. Jean-Marie slid into the chair across from him, his eyes locking onto the colonel's piercing gaze. "Bonjour, Colonel," he said, his voice low and even. "Lenzi," the colonel replied, his voice like gravel. "I trust you're prepared to discuss the latest developments in our... arrangement?" Jean-Marie nodded, his mind racing with the implications of their conversation. We need someone with your... particular set of skills to infiltrate and gather intelligence." Jean-Marie's gut tightened, his mind racing with the possibilities. This was the kind of mission that could make his career, or get him killed. But he knew that he had no choice; as a militaires du contingent, it was his duty to serve his country, no matter the cost.
